actual_measure: length of canonical rendered content encoded as UTF-8, in bytes
reporting_limit: These recorded caps are conservative byte bounds, not measured model-token budgets. Cap rejection does not prove that a profile exceeds the same numerical budget under a provider tokenizer. Structural overhead and encoding are included in the serialized count.
scope: Existing frozen runtime convention, not a newly found execution defect or changed cap policy.
measurement_scope: Rendered personalization content only; not the full consumer prompt, context/options/system instructions, or an API output-token limit.
